name: Hikari ni Tsuite no Kage no Uta: Chapter A
source:
2007. Japan.

A high school student Katashi Sato, moves to a new city and enters a new school. In it, he gets acquainted with a company of local students: Sajori Hino, Aya Kimura, Kasumi Tsukumo and Akagi Kioto. Katashi begins to get along with the company, strengthens relationships and becomes attached to his new friends. Over time, he begins to notice something strange about every company member. And at some point story transforms from a peaceful life of a student into terrifying nightmare and trying to survive.
translation:
2007.日本。

高中生佐藤克志搬到了新的城市并进入了新的学校。在其中，他结识了一群当地学生：日野狭里、木村彩、津云霞和赤城木人。卡西开始与公司相处，加强关系，并与新朋友产生了依恋。随着时间的推移，他开始注意到每个公司成员都有一些奇怪的地方。在某些时候，故事从学生的平静生活转变为可怕的噩梦并试图生存。
